verdicts.rationale: Frege's 'Negation' ('Die Verneinung'), originally published in Beiträge zur Philosophie des Deutschen Idealismus (1918/1919), later reprinted in English in Logical Investigations (Blackwell). Same essay: a original-journal entry and b English collection reprint. Year off by one reflects the 1918-1919 straddle of the original publication.

Different Frege essays. 'Compound Thoughts' and 'Thoughts' ('Der Gedanke') are two separate works. The shared DOI 10.1093/mind/lxxii.285.1 actually belongs to Mind LXXII(285) which is 'Compound Thoughts'; it is an erroneous/placeholder DOI on the 'Thoughts' entry. Titles are distinct works, so not the same.

Both are Friston, 'The free-energy principle: a unified brain theory?', Nature Reviews Neuroscience, 2010, vol 11, pp 127-138. a's title has the truncated 'Nat' and journal 'Rev. Neurosci.' split into the journal field (Nature Reviews Neuroscience). Identical work; b has the full DOI 10.1038/nrn2787.

Two distinct review articles. a: Galantucci & Garrod, 'Experimental Semiotics: A Review', Frontiers in Human Neuroscience, 2011, DOI 10.3389/fnhum.2011.00011. b: Galantucci, Garrod & Roberts, 'Experimental Semiotics', Language and Linguistics Compass, 2012, DOI 10.1002/lnc3.351. Different journals, different DOIs, different author lists, different years.

Both are Gallistel (& Gibbon), 'The Symbolic Foundations of Conditioned Behavior/Behaviour', 2002, Lawrence Erlbaum / L. Erlbaum Associates. Same book; a includes co-author Gibbon, b lists only Gallistel and adds ISBN. Trivial title/spelling variance.

Both are Gallistel (& Gibbon), 'The Symbolic Foundations of Conditioned Behavior/Behaviour', 2002, L. Erlbaum. Same book; b includes co-author Gibbon, a lists only Gallistel with ISBN. Identical work.

Both are Garey & Johnson, 'Computers and Intractability: A Guide to the Theory of NP-Completeness', 1979, W. H. Freeman. b has a truncated title ('Computers and intractability') but same authors, year, publisher; ISBN confirms the canonical work. Low title jaccard is only due to truncation.

Both are Gazdar, 'Pragmatics: Implicature, Presupposition and Logical Form', 1979, Academic Press. b has truncated title 'Pragmatics' but same author, year, publisher; ISBN 9780122784507 confirms the canonical book. Low jaccard only from truncation.
Both are J. J. Gibson, 'The Perception of the Visual World', 1950, Houghton Mifflin. b has OCR typo 'Tbe' for 'The'. Same author, year, publisher. Identical work.

Two distinct Gibson works. a: 'The Ecological Approach to the Visual Perception of Pictures', article in Leonardo, 1978, DOI 10.2307/1574154. b: 'The Ecological Approach to Visual Perception', book, Houghton Mifflin, 1979, ISBN 9780395270493. Different titles (article about pictures vs. the book), different types, years, and identifiers.
Both are J. J. Gibson, 'The Ecological Approach to Visual Perception', 1979, Houghton Mifflin. b has OCR typo 'Tbe' for 'The'. Same author, year, publisher, book. Identical work.

Two parts of a serialized study. a: 'Report on an Experimental Test of Musical Expressiveness', Am. J. Psychology vol 4(4) p558, DOI 10.2307/1410803. b: 'Report ... (Continued)', vol 5(1) p42, DOI 10.2307/1410813. Different volumes, pages, and DOIs — the '(Continued)' second installment is a distinct bibliographic unit.

Two distinct works. a: Goldin-Meadow & Mylander, 'Gestural Communication in Deaf Children: Noneffect of Parental Input on Language Development', Science, 1983, DOI 10.1126/science.6867713. b: a much longer-author Monograph 'The Effects and Noneffects of Parental Input on Early Language Development', Monographs SRCD, 1984, DOI 10.2307/1165838. Different journals, author lists, titles, years, DOIs.

Both are Goldin-Meadow, 'Hearing Gesture(s): How Our Hands Help Us Think', 2003. a is a PsycEXTRA dataset record (a for the book), b is the Harvard University Press book. Same underlying work; a's 'Gestures' plural is a minor variant.

Different works. a: Gombrich, 'Art and Illusion', 2nd edition, book, Princeton UP, 1972. b: 'Illusion and Art', a chapter in the collection 'Nature and Art', Duckworth, 1973. The essay in an edited volume is not the same as the monograph despite overlapping words.

Both are Douglas Gomery, 'Shared Pleasures: A History of Movie Presentation in the United States', 1992. a lists publisher BFI, b University of Wisconsin Press (the book was co-published BFI/UW Press) with ISBN. Same book; b's citekey is a mislabel but fields match.

Both are Milner & Goodale, 'The Visual Brain in Action', Oxford University Press. a dated 1996 (paperback/reprint), b 1995 (first edition). Same authors and title; the ±1 year is edition printing. Same work.
Both are Milner & Goodale, 'The Visual Brain in Action', Oxford University Press. a 1996, b 1995; same title and authorship. Same book, ±1 year edition. b is a duplicate of milner1995visual.
Both are Jane Goodall, 'The Chimpanzees of Gombe: Patterns of Behavior', 1986, Belknap/Harvard University Press (Belknap is Harvard's imprint). b has OCR typo 'Bombe' for 'Gombe'. Same book.

Both are Nelson Goodman, 'Fact, Fiction, and Forecast', originally 1954. a's title/author fields are garbled ('), Fact, Fiction, and Forecast, University of London, Athlone Press' / 'Goodman and (') but clearly the same work, publisher Athlone Press; b is the same book (1954, Bobbs-Merrill/Harvard first ed). Same work.
